prompt.text:
Implement a new deterministic action-shelf registry. Export `ShelfLocation`, `ShelfAction`, and `ActionShelfRegistry`. Valid locations are `'canvas/tools'` and `'outline/actions'`. The constructor optionally accepts a warning callback. `register(location, action)` rejects invalid locations, blank command IDs, and non-finite or non-integer priorities by warning and making no change. Missing priority means 0; missing group means the empty string. Registering an existing command at the same location replaces it while retaining its original registration position for tie-breaking. `remove(location, commandId)` removes only the exact command at that location; invalid locations simply warn. `list(location)` returns an empty array for invalid locations and otherwise returns fresh action objects sorted by group ascending, priority ascending, then original registration position. Returned objects must not expose mutable internal state.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
